title: Picking the musicians for the 1933 band
summary: Randolph chose the Oldham boys and Mike McKendrick sent in trumpeter Stump Whitlock, after Armstrong wired both of them.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Well, when Louis came back to the United States, --
You put together another band for him. Now, still talking about the '33 band.
Did he write to you or wire you, or -- you picked the musicians this time, didn't you?
Uh-huh. Well, how did Louis contact you?
Now, what band is this? This must be the --
This is the one with Budd Johnson and Teddy Wilson and Yank Porter, the '33 band.
'33 band, yeah. Oh, uh-huh. Well, I
picked some. I picked the Olden boys. Mike McKendrick had -- he sent in that little fellow by the name of Stump Whitlock.
So Mike says, I'll get Stumpy Whitlock. Course, Mike had gotten a telegram from Louis and I got a telegram from Louis. Louis wired both of us.

And so Mike was still the -- being the go-between the managers, taking care of -- having them go down and pick out the uniforms, and having them to tell you what your boys wear and such things like that, and I took care of the music. And the arranging.
